requirements: The agent-tracing paper core contributions have been reproduced as executable tooling and trace-language artifacts.

sub_tasks.requirements: Trace language formalization is implemented as a machine-checkable CSV schema validator.
A validator enforces the 20-column Rogii swim-lane header and rejects malformed headers.
The validator enforces single-action rows (at most one non-empty cell per row after governance rows 2-4).
The validator checks pipeline closure (dependency-graph orchestrator reaches serialize/topological_order).
Chomsky hierarchy classifier and verifier are implemented per frontier.yaml smart contract.
Classifier emits chomsky_classification_v1 JSON with agent_id, predicted_chomsky_class, sigma_trace_alphabet_encoding, structural_witnesses, and memory_hypothesis.
Verifier emits verification_report_v1 with PASS/FAIL checks appropriate to the declared Chomsky class.
Type-0 envelope detection flags subprocess/HTTP/CLI patterns (kaggle, sbatch, uv, curl) in trace cells.
Rogii preprocessing trace language variants are present and validate.
All six preprocessing variants validate: baseline_column_transformer, typewell_gr_alignment, ps_point_leakage_aware, robust_scale_log1p, parallel_multiwell_loader, formation_plane_spatial.
Trace cells include CLI-for-agents commands (kaggle download, sbatch train, uv pip install) where training/submission steps occur.
Evaluation audit protocol and PaperBench hooks are documented and runnable.
reproduce.sh runs trace validation and Chomsky classification for all variants without manual steps.
README maps concrete implementation modules to agent schemata (control-state audit, memory audit, trace logging).
